vb_textbox.text: I Placed my fingers on the relevant keys, whilst focusing I noticed there was a run on high scores on purple hats, I tested my theory clicking on the opposite colour hat, then for a while I kept clicking pink or purple on either side.  When the scores were a low I switched to the other coloured hats.  I also wondered if the high yield related to the particular sized gnomes so I tested that theory as well.  It is very easy to forget to press the space bar to collect the mushrooms, I did this a couple of times at first but soon got into the swing of pressing the keys quickly.  My advice is to stay focused and look for patterns or sequences.
